description.text: The second Neo set, released in June 2001 with 75 cards and two theme decks, Brain Wave and Wallop. Its Pokémon center on ruins, its set symbol is a temple, and it brought the first Unown: nine of the letters, each with an effect tied to a word starting with its letter, such as Unown O, which observes the opponent's deck. Like Jungle, it has no Energy cards.
